issue.title: High-cardinality GROUP BY shuffle dominated by per-frame Arrow IPC encode

relevant_locations.role: Defines MPP shuffle queue and ring size GUC parameters governing shuffle backpressure and frame sizing.

llm_context.input_title: High-cardinality GROUP BY shuffle dominated by per-frame Arrow IPC encode
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: High-cardinality GROUP BY queries running under ParadeDB's MPP framework suffer from poor performance due to excessive per-frame Arrow IPC serialization overhead during hash shuffle and a non-reducing partial pre-aggregation stage that unnecessarily passes full row counts through a hash pass.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The root cause stems from the MPP shuffle transport layer encoding self-contained Arrow IPC streams per frame with repeated schema definitions, combined with an eager partial aggregation stage that performs a hash pass even when row reduction is negligible.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect MPP GUC configurations
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect symbol MPP_QUEUE_SIZE and related shuffle settings in pg_search/src/gucs.rs to understand queue sizing and frame serialization parameters.

step_by_step_plan.title: Optimize Arrow IPC serialization overhead
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the MPP hash shuffle transport layer to write the Arrow schema once per channel rather than redundantly per frame, reducing overhead during high-cardinality GROUP BY execution.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement batch coalescing and pre-aggregation bypass
step_by_step_plan.description: Add logic to coalesce small per-partition batches before encoding and conditionally bypass the partial pre-aggregation stage when estimated cardinality approaches the input row count.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test for high-cardinality GROUP BY
step_by_step_plan.description: Implement a regression test covering high-cardinality GROUP BY queries under the MPP framework to assert correct performance and output correctness.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run test suite verification
step_by_step_plan.description: Run cargo test to ensure all existing and newly added regression tests pass successfully without regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: The cost of serializing record batches and schema metadata into the Apache Arrow IPC stream format for inter-process or network transport.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: When a stream is split into many small frames that repeatedly re-encode the schema, serialization CPU overhead and payload size explode, choking shuffle performance.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: High-cardinality shuffles produce numerous small per-partition batches where per-frame schema re-serialization dominates the `send_time`.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: An optimization phase that aggregates rows locally before shuffling them across workers to reduce network transfer volume.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: If group key cardinality is nearly equal to the total row count, local aggregation yields virtually zero row reduction while adding unnecessary CPU hashing overhead.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Running a partial AggregateExec on high-cardinality keys wastes CPU cycles on a hash pass and populates shuffles with unreduced row volumes.

common_pitfalls: Assuming that increasing `paradedb.mpp_queue_size` will resolve serialization-bound shuffle delays.
Modifying shuffle queue sizes without addressing per-frame schema encoding overhead.
